question: Compare Q3 and Q4 performance for our best region.
sql:
WITH best_region AS (
    SELECT region
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY region
    ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-Q%q', o.order_date) AS quarter,
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN
    best_region br ON c.region = br.region
WHERE
    strftime('%Y-Q%q', o.order_date) IN ('Q3', 'Q4')
GROUP BY
    quarter
ORDER BY
    quarter;
